name: welcome
description: Greets new members with a welcome card, posts goodbye cards on leave, assigns join roles, and optionally sends a DM greeting.
short: Welcome cards, goodbye cards, join roles, and DM greetings.
endUserDataStatement: No persistent user data. Join and leave events are rendered into cards at delivery time and are not stored.

configFields.label: Welcome Message Enabled
configFields.description: Post a welcome card when a member joins.

configFields.label: Welcome Channel
configFields.description: Channel where welcome cards are posted.

configFields.label: Welcome Template
configFields.description: Posted when a member joins. Placeholders: {user} mention, {userId}, {username}, {nickname}, {userAvatarUrl}, {server}, {serverId}, {serverIconUrl}, {memberCount} (alias {memberNumber}). Unknown placeholders are left as-is. A line containing only --- inserts a divider.

configFields.label: Accent Color
configFields.description: Accent bar color for the welcome card as hex (e.g. #5865F2).

configFields.label: Thumbnail
configFields.description: Small image shown beside the welcome text. Image URL.

configFields.label: Images
configFields.description: Image URLs shown as a gallery on the welcome card (max 10).

configFields.label: Footer
configFields.description: Small footer line under the welcome card. Falls back to the auto-role line when empty.

configFields.label: Advanced Layout
configFields.description: Optional block-based layout (Section, Media Gallery, Separator, Action Row) for the welcome card. When it has any blocks, it replaces the plain template and rich fields above.

configFields.label: Goodbye Message Enabled
configFields.description: Post a goodbye card when a member leaves.

configFields.label: Goodbye Channel
configFields.description: Channel where goodbye cards are posted.

configFields.label: Goodbye Template
configFields.description: Posted when a member leaves. Placeholders: {user} mention, {userId}, {username}, {nickname}, {userAvatarUrl}, {server}, {serverId}, {serverIconUrl}, {memberCount} (alias {memberNumber}). Unknown placeholders are left as-is. A line containing only --- inserts a divider.

configFields.label: Advanced Layout
configFields.description: Optional block-based layout (Section, Media Gallery, Separator, Action Row) for the goodbye card. When it has any blocks, it replaces the plain template above.

configFields.label: Auto Roles
configFields.description: Roles assigned automatically when a member joins.

configFields.label: DM Greeting Enabled
configFields.description: Send the new member a DM greeting on join.

configFields.label: DM Greeting Template
configFields.description: Sent as a DM to new members. Placeholders: {user} mention, {userId}, {username}, {nickname}, {userAvatarUrl}, {server}, {serverId}, {serverIconUrl}, {memberCount} (alias {memberNumber}). Unknown placeholders are left as-is. A line containing only --- inserts a divider.
